question: Which product category had the lowest gross margin percentage in 2025, and which product in that category sold the most units in 2025? Give the product's ID, name and units sold in 2025.
plan: Calculate the gross margin percentage for each product category in 2025 (gross margin = total revenue minus total cost, divided by total revenue) to identify the category with the lowest margin.
Find the units sold in 2025 for each product within that lowest-margin category and return the product ID, name, and total units sold for the top-selling product.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.category, (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gross_margin_percentage FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025' AND o.status <> 'refunded' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gross_margin_percentage ASC LIMIT 500

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.category = 'Accessories' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND p.category = (SELECT p2.category FROM products AS p2 JOIN order_items AS oi2 ON p2.product_id = oi2.product_id JOIN orders AS o2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.order_id WHERE o2.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p2.category ORDER BY SUM((oi2.unit_price * (1 - oi2.discount)) - p2.unit_cost) / SUM(oi2.unit_price * (1 - oi2.discount)) ASC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 1
